role: second controlled representation for sensitivity comparison with the digitized Figure 7 proxy

source.paper: A. Athenodorou and M. Teper, JHEP 11 (2020) 172
source.figure_context: Figure 7; authors report a well-defined early effective-mass plateau and discuss the later 0++ rise as a statistical fluctuation.

construction.t_support: t/a = 0..10, matching the first Figure-7 proxy support for direct chamber comparison
construction.uncertainty_handling: The published ±0.0022 is a fitted mass uncertainty and is retained as a fully correlated model band in mass_band.csv; it is NOT converted into independent pointwise correlator sigma values.

interpretation_boundary: This is a controlled reference representation, not measured C(t).
Its purpose is to isolate sensitivity to Figure-7 fluctuations/digitization while preserving the published mass scale.
Agreement between the raw figure proxy and this control strengthens robustness; disagreement indicates representation sensitivity.
CORR-I output on this control is not independent evidence for the Yang-Mills mass gap.
